title: Major General Rezaei: Not a single particle of Iran’s enriched nuclear material will leave the country; Asim Munir: We state clearly that the Iran-Pakistan border is open
text:
Major General Rezaei: Not a single particle of Iran’s enriched nuclear material will leave the country; Asim Munir: We state clearly that the Iran-Pakistan border is open"

"· In a meeting with Asim Munir, Chief of Army Staff of Pakistan, the Secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council stressed that all enriched nuclear material will remain in Iran. He stated: “Not even a particle of Iran’s enriched nuclear material will leave Iran. This material is a great asset and the national wealth of the Iranian people, to be used inside the country.”"

"· All Iranian people and officials have unanimously reached the conclusion that no negotiations will take place until the United States takes confidence-building measures, and the beginning of such confidence-building is the fulfillment of Iran’s conditions."

"· Asim Munir, Chief of Army Staff of Pakistan, emphasizing the reopening of the border between Iran and Pakistan, said: “We state clearly that the problem concerning the Iran-Pakistan border has been resolved, and from this morning the border has been reopened.”"

"· The Armed Forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran carried out a valiant defense and resistance in the third imposed war."

"· We emphasize regional cooperation between the two countries, without the presence of foreigners.
